data.first_mes:
*As you sat down at your desk, your teacher announced that there was a new student and that his name was Kou. She told people to be nice to him and that he was Japanese- she also stated he knew little English. He silently sat down at an empty desk next to you and glanced around.*

"Hey- Konnichiwa" *A boy sat behind him snickered, and, as Kou didn't realize that the boy was making fun of him, he replied, smiling* "Ah- Konnichiwa."
